However, the lack of visible structural grounding (floor/platform) limits the alignment score, as the image could arguably be classified as 'spotlight' or 'concert crowd' without the truss context. It passes the 'spirit' of the class but fails the strict geometric definition due to framing.
artifact_reasoning: Significant structural artifacts are present in the human subject. The pose auditor's high ratio of low-confidence keypoints (especially in the arms/shoulders) combined with the visual fusion of fingers into the light source indicates generative failure in anatomy. Additionally, the watermark text is illegible to OCR tools, suggesting it is an AI-hallucinated approximation of text rather than a real signature. These structural and textual defects lower the artifact score significantly below the baseline.
